name: Sichuan Jiuzhou Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Jiuzhou Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of digital audio and video, and data communication terminals in China and internationally. It also provides air traffic control and microwave radio frequency products. In addition, the company offers industrial, commercial, and container energy storage system; AC charging pile; ONT and xDSL products, cable modem, digital TV equipment, TV modular and amplifier, fiber optic transmission equipment, optical components, and WIFI AP products. Sichuan Jiuzhou Electronic Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Mianyang, China.
